outline: The primary focus of the Combinatorial Optimization course is to enable students to design efficent algorithms for discrete applications. This course introduces modern techiniques as well as fundatmental algorithms to solve real world problems.
schedule:
Week 1~2: Introduction to Combinatorial Optimization
Week 3~5: Graph basics and applications
Week 6~7: The greedy algorithm
Week 8~10: Metaheuristics
Week 11: Midterm
Week 12~13: Applications of Metaheuristics
Week 14~15: Advanced combinatorial optimization topics
Week 16: Paper readings
Week 17: Project presentation
Week 18: Final
